purpose: A compact, structure-diverse T1 research queue for an open China public-market universe. It is not a dated T2 decision universe, approved investable universe, portfolio, trade list, distribution objective or allocation instruction.

source_boundary.evidence_status: R0 primary-source capture is complete for the initial 11-item queue. Evidence-limited R1 diligence now exists for the direct-equity, fund/sovereign and REIT groups, but no item has passed R1; R2 valuation, market and execution work remains pending for every item.
source_boundary.archive_boundary: The pre-existing official-20260812 source archive remains unchanged. The initial queue has separately captured source batches in sources/official-continuation-20260814/, sources/official-fund-sovereign-continuation-20260814/, sources/official-fund-sovereign-r1-20260814/ and sources/official-reit-continuation-20260814/. Capture establishes R0 facts and evidence-limited R1 framing only; each later admission claim requires independently reconciled R1/R2 and current-market evidence.
prohibited_inferences: A linked filing or product disclosure makes a candidate investable.
A fund NAV result, distribution rate, coupon, price history or cash-flow distribution rate is investor total return.
A current eligibility, liquidity, tax, valuation, suitability or execution conclusion can be inferred from historical reports.
The queue permanently excludes candidates not listed here.

common_admission_gates: Freeze a dated T2 decision universe with selection, substitution, weighting, rebalancing and available-at rules before reading a result as strategy evidence.
Capture an authoritative or licensed point-in-time total-return, corporate-action, calendar, halt, price-limit, delisting and liquidity archive.
Complete a structure-appropriate R0-R4 item dossier, including current valuation where applicable and a dated source registry.
Reconcile instrument-specific costs, taxes, settlement, account access, market price versus NAV/reference value and capacity.
Pass portfolio-level overlap, common-risk, stress, concentration and independent risk-budget review.
Obtain a current-session market and suitability packet before any future implementation review.
